Base incentive is paid for every submitted feedback. Driver/Cab/Team issue bonus is added when that side is marked negative.

ℹ️ How it works

Each city has its own incentive rates. Checklist changes are reflected for agents after the branch settings are saved. Deleting a reason removes it from new forms only; old feedback records remain unchanged.

Maintain the links shown in the Quick Links tab. Changes are shared with all signed-in users after saving.
